turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there! How's it going today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My old tent finally ripped. I need a new one before the trip.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sorry to hear it. How many people should it sleep, and will you be carrying it far or just parking next to it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, Marcus needs me for a sec. Please stay quiet until I come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Marcus, do we still have that big checkered blanket?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's in the car trunk from the beach trip.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably still has sand on it. Just shake it out.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. Can you grab the cooler from the basement too?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, the blue one or the small one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The blue one, we've got a lot of drinks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm back. You can talk now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. We were figuring out your new tent. How many people, and will you carry it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two people, and we'll hike in about five miles.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then look for a light two-person backpacking tent, ideally under four pounds.
